reasoning.step1:
Document classification:
- Invoice indicators found: "Rechnung", "Rechnungs-Nr.", "Rechnungsdatum", line items, "Gesamtbetrag", "Umsatzsteuer" — classify as invoice.
- No exclusion indicators ("Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung", "Servicebericht") prominent — proceed.

Field extraction candidates from text (verbatim evidence):
- Rechnungsdatum: "Rechnungsdatum                                                           19.01.2024"
- Gesamtbetrag brutto: "Gesamtbetrag                     brutto                                                                                                                                                           7.081,52            EUR"
- Gesamtbetrag netto: "Gesamtbetrag                    netto                                                                                                                                                              6.437,75            EUR"
- Umsatzsteuer 10%: "zzgl.      Umsatzsteuer                   10%                                                                                                                                                          643,77          EUR"
- VAT identifier: "Steuer-Nr,:       ATU14408700"

Verification and interpretation rules:
- No inference: use only explicit values.
- Preserve decimal places as in input; convert German-format numbers (thousands separator dot, decimal comma) to numeric form with dot decimal.
- VAT rate extracted without "%" per rules: "10" not "10%".
- Map amounts:
  - GrandTotal.Amount: use Gesamtbetrag brutto 7.081,52 EUR -> numeric 7081.52
  - Net.Amount: Gesamtbetrag netto 6.437,75 EUR -> numeric 6437.75
  - Vat.Amount: Umsatzsteuer 643,77 EUR -> numeric 643.77

Edge checks:
- Ensure Sender.VatId is the explicit "ATU14408700" labeled "Steuer-Nr," — treat as VAT ID.
- Confirm VAT group: single VAT group 10% applies to entire invoice (present as single line), so include one Vat.Rate/Vat.Amount/Net.Amount group.

No ambiguous alternatives requiring guessing remain.
reasoning.step2:
GrandTotal.Amount — High confidence (≈95%)
- Evidence: Explicit line "Gesamtbetrag brutto ... 7.081,52 EUR".
- Consistency: Matches netto + VAT (6.437,75 + 643,77 = 7.081,52).
- Risk: OCR spacing/formatting unlikely to affect numeric value.

Invoice.Date — High confidence (≈95%)
- Evidence: Explicit "Rechnungsdatum                                                           19.01.2024".
- Consistency: Lieferdatum is same date, reinforcing correctness.
- Risk: Low OCR mis-read of digits.

Sender.VatId — High confidence (≈90%)
- Evidence: "Steuer-Nr,:       ATU14408700" appears in header/footer.
- Consistency: Format matches Austrian VAT ID (ATU...).
- Risk: Minor: label "Steuer-Nr." vs. "VAT ID" but accepted as sender VAT.

Vat.Rate — High confidence (≈95%)
- Evidence: "zzgl. Umsatzsteuer 10%" clearly printed.
- Consistency: Single VAT line for entire invoice.
- Risk: Low.

Net.Amount — High confidence (≈95%)
- Evidence: "Gesamtbetrag netto ... 6.437,75 EUR" explicitly present.
- Consistency: Net + VAT equals grand total.
- Risk: Low.

Vat.Amount — High confidence (≈95%)
- Evidence: "zzgl. Umsatzsteuer 10% ... 643,77 EUR" explicitly present.
- Consistency: Matches calculation from net * 10% = 643.775 → rounded to 643,77 as shown.
- Risk: Very low (rounding consistent with printed value).
